title: Critical semilinear damped wave equations beyond moduli of continuity
summary: We consider the Cauchy problem for semilinear classical damped wave equations with general nonnegative nondecreasing nonlinearities, without imposing a modulus-of-continuity structure or convexity. A Dini-type condition expressed directly in terms of the nonlinearity gives small data global in-time existence and extends the nonlinear framework of Ebert--Girardi--Reissig [Math. Ann. 378 (2020), 1311--1326].
